title: Select a specific sound card in ALSA mixer
summary: If you have multiple sound cards, use this command to choose which one to control in alsamixer.

steps.explain: Launch alsamixer targeting a specific sound card by its number.

placeholders.name: SOUNDCARD_NUMBER
placeholders.description: The index number of the sound card you want to control (e.g., 0, 1).

steps.expect: The alsamixer interface opens showing controls for the specified sound card.
